label: Trailer Set: Flatbed 28/53, Reefer 28/53
generated: measured off the rig source by hand-transcription with per-value provenance; no generator in the rig

frame.origin: ground-centre of the BODY footprint (the reefer nose unit overhang is excluded from the centring; z=0 is the road)
frame.at_rest: every value here is at sus=0, gear=1 (PARKED, shoes grounded), doors shut. The trailers bake at COUPLED RIDE HEIGHT — deck plane 1.18 m — so pairing needs no z shift.

flatbed53._note: 16.15 m needs width AND depth; ground row 300

KINGPIN._what: the coupling half that mates BOTH tractors. The game hinges anchors().kingpin to a tractor's anchors().fifthWheel and articulates the pair — the rig renders a lone trailer and publishes the numbers.

pin._note: the pin hangs under the coupler plate; the coupling PLANE is 1.18 — the fifth-wheel plate top

KINGPIN.swing_basis: sqrt(1.22^2 + 0.90^2) — the nose corners about the kingpin
KINGPIN.verdict: full jackknife clears BOTH tractors' cabs by 4 mm. The 0.90 m set and the 2.44 m width are LOAD-BEARING numbers: widen either and the tractors' published margin is gone.
KINGPIN.unit_basis: sqrt(0.55^2 + 1.18^2) — the nose unit corners; inside the 1.516 m corner swing, so the unit never leads

glad_hands.trailer_side: [0, L/2-0.04, 1.49] per body — pairs with the tractor panel at z 1.98; the lines sag between them

off_tracking_inputs._what: the game's trailer-follow arithmetic wants kingpin-to-axle; published per body, with the tail sweep for swept-path checks

KINGPIN.provenance: G.hw/kpSet/deckZ/kpZ + kpY(S); swing maths mirrors both tractor sidecars' TOW blocks

GEAR.sense: 0 legs UP (coupled, towing) -> 1 legs DOWN, sand shoes grounded (parked — the bake default)

legs.shoe: 0.14 x 0.18 plate, bottom at z 0.00 at gear=1

GEAR.discipline: couple -> gear 0 BEFORE rolling; nothing in the rig stops a game dragging grounded shoes, and it will render exactly that.
GEAR.provenance: buildChassis gear block: drop = 0.25 + gear*0.78, foot = 1.10 - drop

ground_clearance_m.source: ICC bar; the frame rails run at 0.78; grounded gear shoes at 0 when parked

deck.surface: planked lumber over steel rails, stake pockets both rails, 3 winches street side

headboard._note: the front bulkhead; false bares the full deck. Zero swept volume either way.

CARGO.tie_downs: stake pockets every 1.35 m per side + winches — published as ATTACH points, load rules are gameplay's

deck.surface: planked lumber, stake pockets, 6 winches street side

collider_bbox._note: +y end includes the 0.28 m nose unit

door_entry._note: sill = floor, dock height 1.30 — 0.20 over the box trucks' 1.10; quay-vs-floor gaps are the world's problem

collider_bbox._note: +y end includes the 0.28 m nose unit

DOORS._what: reefer rear barn doors — the only doors in the set. Flatbeds clamp barnL/barnR to 0.
DOORS.hinges: vertical, at [±1.19, -L/2+0.02] — the OUTER rear corners

keep_clear._note: the sweep passes through FULL OUTBOARD at 180deg (|x| 2.37) before folding back; at 255deg the leaves lie along the sides and the trailer is 2.60 m wide with doors open. Dock approaches budget the whole fan.

DOORS.hardware: two chrome lock rods + handle per leaf, at |x| 0.38 and 0.80

WHEELS.pattern: duals both sides of every axle: inner tire at |x| 0.60, outer wheel at 0.90 with 10-lug hub and FIVE hand-holes (the odd count is what makes half a revolution visible; one full revolution still closes exactly)
WHEELS.roll: master roll in REVOLUTIONS + per-side wL/wR; each side's axles share the roll. Distance per rev 3.142 m; loop seam 0-1 px (29.008 tread stripes of 0.1083 m).
WHEELS.steering: NONE — trailer axles do not steer. The trailer's heading comes from the hinge; see KINGPIN.off_tracking_inputs.

SUSPENSION.pivot: the KINGPIN: dz is zero at the coupling plane and grows aft — a coupled nose rides the TRACTOR's suspension, and the two meet at the plate
SUSPENSION.applies_to: the whole body group (deck/box, doors, gear, ICC, lamps) — the wheels do NOT move

YAW.what: heading between the eight facings, rebaked under the fixed key — not a rotated sprite.
YAW.pivot: unaffected; the origin projects to the published pivot at any yaw
YAW.coupled: a tractor+trailer pair is two headings hinged at the coupling point. The articulation angle is their difference; the tractors publish the 1.52 m gap it lives inside.

reefer_unit._note: hum/exhaust FX attach at anchors().unit; the unit face is the only glow on the set

marker_lamps.reefers: 3 amber high on the nose, red at the rear roof corners

icc_bar.all: [±0.94, -L/2+0.02..+0.08, 0.40..0.48] — the underride bar both tractor sidecars promised the trailer would bring

INTERACT.reach_point: under the nose — but the ACT is the tractor backing on; the player-facing handle is the tractor's release

_interact_notes.reach_point: a request, not a promise — NOT validated against terrain or the coupled tractor.
_interact_notes.visible_facings: same near-side test as the whole fleet; dir 0 (N) shows the REAR.

_excluded.CLEATS: not a hull. The kingpin is a coupling, not mooring.
_excluded.steer_axle: trailer axles do not steer, and no lift axle is modelled. Heading is the hinge's business.
_excluded.tractor: no tractor in this kit — the pair is assembled by the GAME from two sprites hinged at the coupling point.
_excluded.load: the flatbed deck is EMPTY: no straps, tarps, coils or dunnage. Stake pockets and winches are attach points, not cargo.
_excluded.brake_lines: one slack line and a glad-hand stub on the nose; no full air run is modelled.
_excluded.walkable_roof: the reefer roof at 4.06 m has no rail and no route up. The flatbed DECK is the set's only stand-on surface, and whether players walk it is unruled.
_excluded.fuel_fill: the reefer unit's fuel pack is a slab; no filler is modelled.
_excluded.plates_and_tape: no licence plates, conspicuity tape or decals at 32 px/m.
_excluded.interior_interact: nothing inside the reefer bay is an interactable.

_confirm.coupling_owner: pairing, articulation, off-tracking and jackknife physics are the GAME's. Hinge anchors().kingpin to anchors().fifthWheel; KINGPIN.off_tracking_inputs carries the follow arithmetic.
_confirm.handshake_lock: width 2.44 and set 0.90 are load-bearing — they ARE the tractors' 4 mm margin. A wider or shorter-set body needs the tractors' swing re-run first.
_confirm.gear_discipline: gear=1 grounds the shoes. Tow like that and the rig renders the drag; set gear 0 on couple.
_confirm.door_dock_rule: the door fan reaches |x| 2.37 m at 180deg — wider than the trailer. Budget the full fan at docks, then park the leaves at 255deg (2.60 m overall).
_confirm.coupled_sus: sus pivots at the kingpin, so the coupling plane holds 1.18 while the tail drops — consistent with a tractor that re-reads ITS fifthWheel anchor under load.
_confirm.cell_rule: pups bake in the road cell; the 53s take 640x480 @ 320,300. Pack from THIS contract's per-body painted_bbox, never a sibling's.
_confirm.deck_material: the WOOD ramp is the one addition to the harbour master ramps — deck lumber; every painted part uses the shared ten.
_confirm.lamps: the trailers bring their own tail lights and ICC bar, exactly as both tractor sidecars promise bobtail.
